decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 14 September 2005, the erection of a single storey rear extension measuring 4.5m deep by 6m wide, with a pitched roof with a maximum height of 4m, reducing to 2.7m at the eaves, was lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:

The development falls within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class E of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995.

Condition : 2 - INFORMATIVE:  The detached building hereby found to be lawful shall only be used for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the single-family dwelling house known as 102 Central Avenue and for no other purpose (i.e. it shall not be used as a bedroom, living room, office or other business use or as a separate dwelling and should not include toilet, bathroom or kitchen facilities).
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the erection of a detached single storey gym/store to rear of house
